# Unified Table Design Checklist: Unified Table Processing and Atomic Transaction Optimization

**Purpose**: Review whether the written design requires one storage and processing path for user, shared, stream, and persisted system tables, covering indexes, hot/cold storage, schema history, transactions, live query, and a direct non-SQL mutation API that keeps today's system-table operations.
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are user, shared, stream, and persisted system tables required to share one storage implementation for durable rows, so stream retention and versioned row storage are not separate stores? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-041, Data Model §1.1]
- [ ] CHK002 Is one index implementation required for key extraction, lookup, uniqueness, and tombstone rules across user, shared, stream, and persisted system tables? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK003 Is hot/cold tier movement required to be one implementation for every durable table kind, including stream and persisted system tables? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Is schema history — reading rows stored under an earlier column layout — required for user, shared, stream, and persisted system tables? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-030, Data Model §1.1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is explicit transaction participation required for user, shared, stream, and persisted system tables inside one commit domain? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK006 Are live-query requirements specified for shared, user, and stream tables, including what a subscriber observes after insert, update, and delete? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §US4, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the spec explicitly decide whether persisted system tables participate in live query, since that participation is absent from the current design? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §US4, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 Is a direct insert, update, and delete API that does not go through SQL specified for user, shared, and stream tables as well as persisted system tables? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-041, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the existing persisted-system direct API — point get, index scan, put, update-with-prior, delete, and domain lookups — named as the surface that must remain? [Completeness, Spec §US2 scenario 9, Spec §FR-047, Contract §2.3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 Is "unified" defined so a reader can tell whether it means one provider shell, one storage engine, or both? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec primary architectural acceptance gate, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "common storage" defined so one enum over separate versioned, stream, and direct-keyed engines does not satisfy the requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038, Plan structure decision]
- [ ] CHK012 Are exceptions that allow a second index or hot/cold implementation written as measured limits, with the shared path still required? [Clarity, Spec §FR-044, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK013 Is schema history distinguished from row-format compatibility and from MVCC row-version history? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030, Spec §US7 scenario 2, Data Model §1.1]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the direct non-SQL mutation operations specified with names, key types, and visibility rules that match today's system-table callers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-041, Spec §FR-047]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do the primary architectural gate and FR-001 name the same table kinds for the single maintained provider and processing path? [Consistency, Spec primary architectural acceptance gate, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Does FR-041's separate stream append-log and hot-only system store agree with one storage implementation for stream, shared, system, and user tables? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §FR-041, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Do stream update rejection, explicit-transaction rejection, and disabled cold storage agree with shared transactions and a shared hot/cold path for stream tables? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §US2 scenario 3, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Do system SQL-DML rejection, explicit-transaction rejection, and the ban on version resolution and cold storage agree with transactions, schema history, and shared hot/cold storage for persisted system tables? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §US2 scenario 4, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the primary-key versus secondary-index tombstone policy specified once for system and stream indexes as well as versioned user and shared indexes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020, Contract §4]
- [ ] CHK020 Do the plan and data-model capability rows for transaction mode, cold tier, and scan engine state the same storage and transaction requirements as the spec? [Consistency, Data Model §1.3, Plan summary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Can "no duplicate index or hot/cold code" be decided from SC-005 and SC-013, which score user/shared paths and three table kinds and omit a pass rule for stream and system storage? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK022 Is there a measurable outcome that one storage correction is applied once and observed for user, shared, stream, and persisted system tables? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK023 Are live-query outcomes measurable per table kind, including event order, delete visibility, gap signaling, and whether system tables are in or out? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-004, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK024 Is preservation of the system direct API measurable as the same operations and caches, with SQL reads staying available and SQL DML staying off that path? [Measurability, Spec §SC-015, Spec §FR-047]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements specified for one transaction that changes user, shared, stream, and persisted system rows together, including the rule when a kind cannot participate? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Spec §US1 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK026 Are live-query requirements specified for a shared, user, or stream subscription when the change is made by SQL and when it is made by the direct API? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §US4, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements specified for schema evolution on each table kind, including added columns, removed columns, and reads of rows stored under the previous schema? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-030, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK028 Are computed catalog relations (`pg_catalog`, virtual `system.*`, Kalam `information_schema`) explicitly outside common storage, schema history, transactions, live query, and the direct mutation API? [Coverage, Spec primary architectural acceptance gate, Spec §FR-041]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for a direct-API update or delete of a persisted system row while a SQL reader and a live subscriber are active? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §US2 scenario 4, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for hot/cold movement of a stream or persisted system row when those kinds share tier code and are also described as cold-disabled? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Spec §US2 scenarios 2–4]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for a missing historical schema, a schema-history decode failure, and mixed schema versions inside one transaction? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined so a direct-API write and a SQL write of the same key produce one index outcome? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-040, Spec §FR-006]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 Does the assumption that system tables stay off the versioned engine, and that new stream transactions and cold archival are out of scope, still match common storage, transactions, and schema history for those kinds? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the requirement that system lookups stay off version resolution and cold storage reconciled with placing system rows on the shared storage path? [Assumption, Spec §FR-047, Spec §SC-015, Constitution §I]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK035 Are kind-specific behaviors (expiry, hard delete, SQL-DML rejection, authorization) bounded so they do not clone index, hot/cold, schema-history, transaction, or live-query code? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-043, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK036 Do the tasks that keep a separate stream append-log and keep the system provider off the versioned engine agree with the common-storage requirement? [Conflict, tasks.md Phase B, Spec §FR-041]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Focus of this review: one code path for system, shared, user, and stream tables; shared index and hot/cold storage; schema history; transactions; live query for shared, user, and stream tables with an explicit system-table decision; direct non-SQL insert/update/delete that preserves the system-table API
